tectonExport.notes: Semantic CSS export of the Tecton design system (light + dark blocks). Used here only as `exportAlt` cross-check.

meta.pathConvention: Every `path` is a dot path into tecton.tokens.json exactly as written there (e.g. foundational.color.hotPink.onDark.460 (focus outline), foundational.color.shades.black.transparent.50). `value` is the $value at that path.

sourceValues.tecton-astryx: value decided in tecton-astryx (theme code is authoritative over its docs)
sourceValues.proposed: no Tecton decision exists; proposed here, needs owner approval
sourceValues.upstream-default: Tecton made no change; Astryx default kept (tecton-astryx also kept it)

meta.lightModeDecision: OPEN. `light` = tecton-astryx derived value (same family+stop, onLight ramp). `exportAlt.light` = the Tecton export light value where a matching role exists; 114/161 comparable roles differ. Owner must choose before light sign-off; see tecton-theme.md §3.4.

--color-accent.notes: Primary action fill (violet 220). A FILL, not ink: 2.2:1 on body - never use as text/icon/focus colour (theme-audit §15).

--color-accent-muted.notes: 25% violet wash; selection/hover tint derived from accent.

--color-neutral.notes: Secondary action fill, also the system neutral.

--color-background-surface.notes: Tecton elevation runs DARK in dark mode: a panel is darker than the page. In light mode the derived value is lighter than body (light-mode.md weak point 3).

--color-background-muted.notes: Borrowed from the filled-input background (no Tecton "muted surface" role). Also used as code-block/kbd/syntax background and table stripe fallback.

--color-overlay.notes: Modal scrim, black 50% in both modes (heavy in light mode; light-mode.md weak point 6).

--color-overlay-hover.notes: No Tecton source. Ink wash (black in light, white in dark) at 5%; was 10% until theme-audit §16 (icon-secondary on a 20% pressed row fell to 2.44:1). light-mode.md still quotes the old 10/20 - code is authoritative.

--color-text-disabled.notes: Fails 4.5:1 by design (WCAG 1.4.3 exempts inactive controls).

--color-text-accent.notes: Tecton links carry no colour; this is the lilac adornment ink. Link default colour is re-pointed to text-primary at component level.

--color-on-dark.notes: Fixed: dark side of Text primary in both modes.

--color-on-light.notes: Fixed: dark side of Text inverse (#131214) in both modes.

--color-icon-secondary.notes: Icons draw one step dimmer than adjacent text. Re-pointed to the label ink inside hovered/pressed buttons and on table headers (contrast fixes).

--color-success.notes: Filled severity colour - a fill; ChatToolCalls re-points to text-green when used as ink.

--color-success-muted.notes: WASH (25% alpha), not Tecton "success Muted" (a solid, kept as --tecton-color-success-muted).

--color-border.notes: Divider subtle - the default Astryx border maps to Tecton's LOW emphasis rule.

--color-border-emphasized.notes: Divider medium. 2.2:1 on body - fails 1.4.11 (inherited from the design, pinned by test). Use divider-strong where a boundary must be perceived.

--color-tint-hover.notes: Mixed into surfaces with color-mix() by components for hover.

--color-background-cyan.notes: azure 25% wash. cyan and teal both take azure (Tecton has no separate teal).

--color-background-purple.notes: lilac 25% wash. lilac - not on the Accents page; the ramp the primary action adornment comes from.

--color-background-yellow.notes: lemon 25% wash. lemon (not the amber "yellow" status family).
